scope: Name/contact rendering ablation and one downstream classification task; not a privacy guarantee

corpus_info.name: linked
corpus_info.realism: synthetic: template-written support tickets about real-looking US people; gold is exact by construction
corpus_info.caveats: templates, not human or model writing, so phrasing repeats and detectors may find it easy; US adults only, one store, English; contact details and ids are random; names are two words with distinct surnames; entity ids hold across documents, and the scorer pairs mentions across documents

comparison.varied: changed PERSON and CONTACT rendering only
comparison.shared: input tables, detected spans, resolved owners, keep decisions, dates, IDs, addresses, locations, demographics and all other output

corpus_info.realism: human-written role-play chats; identities come from scenario cards
corpus_info.caveats: gold spans are derived by searching for scenario values; PII not on the card is missing
